title: BatchCompressionRequest
description: Request payload for creating standard archives with cache-aware batch small-file aggregation.

outputArchivePath.description: Absolute target file path for the output archive.

inputPaths.description: List of source file or directory paths to be archived.

skipMacJunk.description: Flag to exclude .DS_Store and __MACOSX resource fork artifacts.

cacheAwareBatchEnabled.description: Explicit toggle for Blosc2-inspired L1/L2 cache-aware small file batch clustering.

targetBatchUnitSizeBytes.description: Target aggregate payload size per batch unit in bytes (128KB default).

maxFilesPerBatch.description: Maximum number of small files clustered in a single batch work unit.

password.description: Optional encryption passphrase for password-protected archives.
